rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a romantic song.

example.english: This ballad is really perfect for listening to at night.
example.traditional: 呢首情歌真係好適合夜晚聽。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 cing4 go1 zan1 hai6 hou2 sik1 hap6 je6 maan5 teng1

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the romantic song is slow-paced rather than focusing on its love theme.

example.english: Let’s add more slow ballad songs to tonight’s playlist; the mood will be much more relaxed.
example.traditional: 今晚個歌單加多啲慢歌，氣氛會舒服好多。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 go3 go1 daan1 gaa1 do1 di1 maan6 go1 hei3 fan1 wui5 syu1 fuk6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for a ballad understood primarily as a narrative poem rather than a popular song.

example.english: This ballad recounts the life of an ordinary hero.
example.traditional: 呢首敘事詩講述一個平民英雄嘅一生。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 zeoi6 si6 si1 gong2 seot6 jat1 go3 ping4 man4 jing1 hung4 ge3 jat1 saang1
